summary.intent: Determine whether phase 73 (cipher-box) had open discussion points before planning, then kick off `/gsd-plan-phase 73` ensuring the correct branch name was used and that tangential pending todos were folded into scope.
summary.outcome: Phase 73 planning pipeline completed end-to-end on the correct branch (`feat/shared-write-navigation-correctness-web`): two tangential todos were folded in as new success criteria (SC6, SC7), research/pattern-mapping/planning/verification all ran, plan-checker found and the assistant fixed 2 blockers + 1 warning, and the checker passed on re-verification, yielding 9 plans across 3 waves ready for `/gsd-execute-phase 73`.

repo: GSD `phase_branch_template` is `feat/{slug}`; the correct branch name is the phase directory slug with the number stripped (e.g. phase 72 used `feat/sdk-write-plane-durability-and-correctness`), not the planner's occasional stray `docs/plan-phase-{N}` branch.

plan-phase.md workflow Step 0 has a 'Git Branch Invariant': it must not create/rename/switch branches during planning — pre-creating the correctly-named feat branch before invoking the skill anchors all subsequent commits to it.
PATTERNS.md produced by gsd-pattern-mapper is not auto-committed by the plan-phase workflow and must be committed explicitly.

`useSharedWriteOps.ts` never calls `runWithFailureUx`; a real API 410 currently surfaces as an uncaught AxiosError instead of a handled tombstone state — SC4 is actually 4 stacked gaps, not the single wiring task the source todo implied.
In the shared-write nav rework, `fetchShareKeys` must be preserved when removing the dead folder-IPNS path — only that specific dead path should be deleted, not the whole function (SC7 landmine).
web-e2e in this repo is gated to run only on main-push, not on phase branches in CI, so SC1/SC2/SC4 end-to-end validation must be run locally against VALIDATION.md's sampling plan before shipping.

code.finding: TDD RED-task verify command piped through `grep ... || true`, masking the real test exit code so the 'confirm RED' gate could never fail; fixed to check the actual exit code.
Same RED-gate exit-code-masking anti-pattern as 73-02-PLAN.md; fixed identically.
`depends_on` frontmatter listed only [73-07, 73-01] but was missing an implicit ordering dependency on 73-05 (item 4); added 73-05 without changing the plan's wave (3).

workflow: Before running `/gsd-plan-phase`, check for a `73-*` planning directory, DISCUSSION.md, and open-question markers in source todos to decide if a discuss-phase pass is warranted — a tight ROADMAP entry with concrete success criteria and no markers means it's safe to skip straight to planning.
When asked to fold 'tangential' pending todos into a phase, delegate classification of the full pending-todos backlog to a subagent rather than reading each one manually, to conserve context.

Mechanical, fully-specified plan-checker findings (like exit-code masking or a missing depends_on) can be fixed directly by the orchestrator instead of re-spawning the full planner, then re-verified with a fresh plan-checker pass rather than trusting the fix silently.

friction: STATE.md was stale — still showed Phase 72 as 'verifying' even though PR #602 had already merged to main; had to be manually advanced without touching progress counters (phase-72 formal completion was out of scope for this task).

The WRITE-03 source todo understated SC4's actual scope, presenting it as a single wiring decision when research revealed 4 stacked gaps (missing `runWithFailureUx` call, unhandled AxiosError, no live supplier, no e2e classifier flow).
First plan-checker pass surfaced 2 blockers (duplicated exit-code-masking bug in two separate plan files) + 1 warning, requiring a second verification iteration to confirm the gate.
open_items: 3 genuinely-separate pending todos (SDK merge parity, SDK ShareCallbacks scaffolding retirement, D-07 ESLint boundary rule) were deliberately left out of phase 73 and remain in the backlog.
Phase 72's formal completion in STATE.md progress counters was left untouched and still needs to be closed out separately.
Local stack run of SC1/SC2/SC4 end-to-end flows recommended before shipping, since web-e2e CI doesn't cover the phase branch.
Next step handed off to the user: run `/gsd-execute-phase 73` (Wave 1 has 5 fully parallel plans: 73-01, 73-02, 73-03, 73-04, 73-06).
